subject.title: feat: add interactive launcher menu as thin wrapper over existing CLI

question: Should OpenClaw make an explicit exception to its terminal-first setup direction and own a separately distributed Rust launcher executable?
rationale: Code repair cannot decide whether core should acquire another executable, toolchain, packaging, and support surface when VISION.md directs GUI ergonomics toward companion apps and warns against convenience wrappers hiding setup decisions.

options.title: Keep canonical entry points
options.body: Decline this standalone launcher and place discoverability improvements in the CLI, onboarding, docs, Windows Hub, and macOS app.

options.title: Sponsor a launcher exception
options.body: Approve a narrow launcher contract, identify its distribution owner, and require removal of duplicated policy plus exact-head cross-platform proof.

recommendation.title: Keep canonical entry points
recommendation.body: Decline this standalone launcher and place discoverability improvements in the CLI, onboarding, docs, Windows Hub, and macOS app.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history signal links this person to recent consolidation of the app, platform, update, and packaging surfaces this product choice would affect.
